Requirements You witnessed an enemy harm an ally with a Strike or spell last round.

When you see a foe hurt one of your allies, your righteous retribution causes your weapon to sprout holy thorns. Make a Strike against the triggering enemy. If you hit and deal damage, the target must also succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure).

Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you. You gain holy sanctification. Select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.5MjSsuKOLBoiL8FB]{freedom} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.EEZvDB1Z7ezwaxIr.JournalEntryPage.DI3MYGIK8iEycanU]{zeal} domain. You gain the initial domain spell for that domain. If you don't have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You can Refocus by praying to Milani or by working with others to plan a just uprising. You become trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC, and your spellcasting attribute for these spells is Wisdom.

Special You can choose this feat a second time, gaining the initial domain spell of the domain you didn't gain the first time.
